standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, lemma generic-point-exists (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Generic points exist after an etale surjection.

standard_prerequisites.name: Decency pullback
standard_prerequisites.use: Decency of the pullback fibre points.

core_obligations: Take a surjective etale cover U -> X; the generic point of an irreducible component of X lifts to U.
The lift is a point of U over x with decent fibre by the pullback stability.
Push down: the image is the generic point and its fibre over the component is the required decent point.
proof_roadmap: Cover lift; decency of the lift; push-down.
difficulty_reason: A three-step existence argument; the push-down identification is the substance.
